companyProfile.business_description: Ingecart is an agile industrial engineering integrator specializing in end-of-line automation, intelligent material handling, and intralogistics for the corrugated packaging industry. Based in Subirats, Barcelona (Catalunya), the company provides standardized product solutions — AMR systems, palletizers, Retal scrap management, Easy Pack, and Ingetrans heavy transport — as well as custom-engineered projects with fast, measurable ROI. With 9 employees and strong OEM-agnostic engineering DNA, Ingecart is positioned as 'faster than OEMs, more reliable than low-cost' for corrugated plants across Europe and the USA.
companyProfile.objectives: 1. Reach €3.5M annual revenue by 2028 (from current €2.5M). 2. Shift revenue mix: 80% standard products / 14% custom projects / 6% services. 3. Scale service capacity from 2,000 h/year to 24,500 h/year potential (14 technicians target). 4. Activate Top-10 account development program with structured KAM. 5. Deploy USA and European agent network. 6. Launch 3 productized offer packages: Quick Throughput Pack, Smart Changeover Cell, Greenfield Assist. 7. Establish weekly sales discipline (45-min cadence) and monthly/quarterly business reviews.
companyProfile.strategy_context: Three-pillar growth model: (1) Standard Products — core engine targeting €2.8M with 4-6 AMR, 5-7 Easy Pack, 6-10 Retal, 1-2 Palletizer per year; (2) Custom Projects — selective at €0.5M/year, strategy or innovation-driven; (3) Services — recurring revenue from maintenance contracts, spare parts, remote support, growing from €0.2M to €1.1M+ at scale. 18-month roadmap Phase 1 (0-3m): brand + foundations; Phase 2 (4-10m): Top-10 workshops, ABM campaigns, ROI-first pilots; Phase 3 (10-18m): scaling programs. Commercial governance: Weekly Sales (45min pipeline), Monthly Business Review (P&L + risks), Quarterly Business Review (strategy refresh).
companyProfile.market_context: Corrugated packaging market driven by e-commerce growth, plant consolidation post-M&A (IP×DS Smith, Smurfit×WestRock mergers), PPWR/EUDR regulation, OEE pressure, and automation investment. Spain: AFCO ecosystem ~65+ member companies representing ~93% of national production. Priority targets: Tier 1 groups (Saica, DS Smith, Smurfit WestRock, Hinojosa, Klingele) for corporate entry; converting/box plants (La Plana, Santorromán, Ondupack, Onducart) for core recurring revenue. Indirect channel via OEM subcontracting (Valmet, Voith). Ingecart competes at 3 layers simultaneously: agile integrators (core), large OEMs (high CAPEX), and Asian low-cost (price pressure). Strategic sweet spot: plants with a problem that need fast ROI, not corporate procurement.

products.name: AMR Systems
products.comments: Core scalable product. Automated material routing for corrugated end-of-line. Target: 4–6 units/year = ~€1.0M annual revenue. OEE improvement focus. Medium sales cycle (3–5 months).

products.name: Easy Pack
products.comments: Volume driver product. Automated packing systems for corrugated converting. Target: 5–7 units/year = ~€0.9M annual revenue. High SKU variability compatibility. Fast ROI.

products.name: Palletizer
products.comments: High-value robotic palletizing system. Target: 1–2 units/year = ~€0.6M annual revenue. Strategic upside. Longer sales cycle (6–9 months). High margin potential.

products.name: Ingetrans
products.comments: Strategic flagship — heavy corrugated board transport systems. ~0.6 units/year = ~€0.7M revenue. Highest single-deal risk and reward. USA market priority. Requires C-level relationship.

products.name: Retal
products.comments: Scrap/trim management system. High frequency, low price = volume. Target: 6–10 units/year = ~€0.7M annual revenue. Fastest ROI product (<12 months). Strong recurring installed base.

products.name: Service & Maintenance
products.comments: Annual maintenance contracts + T&M interventions. €45/h rate, €30/h cost, €15/h margin. Current capacity: ~2,000 h/year in Catalunya. Scale target: 14 technicians = 24,500 h = €1.1M revenue potential.

products.name: Custom Engineering Projects
products.comments: Bespoke industrial automation. Strategic role only. Target: €0.5M/year. Selected for innovation, strategic accounts, or complex solutions. Not required for survival — chosen, not needed.

products.name: Quick Throughput Pack
products.comments: 4–8 week deployment. Focus: logistics optimization, scrap reduction, safety improvements. ROI < 12–15 months. Entry offer for new account activation.

products.name: Smart Changeover Cell
products.comments: 8–12 week deployment. Focus: robotics + OEE improvement for high-variability SKU plants. ROI < 12–18 months. Targets converting plants with frequent changeovers.

products.name: Greenfield Assist
products.comments: 12–24 weeks. Full end-of-line project integration for new or converted plants. Strategic accounts only. Highest relationship and complexity requirement.
